scope: Independent read-only review of root's prompt-detection fix using the actual saved attempt007 console. Replay used a fake serial port and temporary private files; no device, SSH, build, source edit or goal API call. Only this report is written.

candidate.root_reported_attempt008: Same candidate002, reviewed helper/controller, runtime150; active execution and recovery are owned by root. This report does not assess attempt008 runtime.

real_input_evidence.context: Root reported a real PID3 single-user shell prompt after PID1 launchd and PID2 launchctl. The original launcher did not send the automatic challenge because the prompt ends in terminal control sequences. No successful nonce response was added to the replay input.

source_review.normalization: Remove NUL padding and complete seven-bit CSI sequences matching ESC [ parameter bytes 0x30-0x3f, intermediate bytes 0x20-0x2f and final byte 0x40-0x7e; convert CR to newline for prompt matching only.
source_review.stream_handling: ConsoleSession normalizes the accumulated raw tail, allowing a CSI sequence split across serial reads to complete before detection. The unchanged one-shot sent_at gate prevents duplicate challenges.
source_review.raw_preservation: ConsoleSession writes received bytes directly to console.bin and retains the same raw bytes in ConsoleProof.output. No CSI/NUL stripping is applied to evidence or nonce-response matching.
source_review.response_normalization: Both helper and independent controller drop CR bytes to handle observed CRCRLF output. They continue to require complete nonce-delimited Darwin/arm64/version lines. Command input contains split nonce literals; command echo alone does not contain the complete expected marker.
source_review.findings: No blocker found in this bounded prompt-detection change. Prompt recognition sends a challenge; it does not itself establish command execution or complete the user goal.

checks_independently_run.scope: Host-only tests including threaded fake ConsoleSession, split CSI/bracketed-paste prompt, exact single command, preserved raw log, false proof without response, and negative echo/OS/architecture cases.
Host-only controller tests; no device backend opened.

independent_actual_console_replay.method: Pass the saved raw console to the reviewed ConsoleSession through an injected fake serial factory. Fake writes record the command without executing it. Check private temporary console.bin and console-result.json after the reader closes.

chunkings.pattern: All bytes except the last two, followed by the last two bytes; splits the final CSI sequence

independent_actual_console_replay.command_check: In both runs the sole recorded write equals that ConsoleProof instance's exact split-literal challenge command.
independent_actual_console_replay.limitation: Offline replay validates host behavior on real captured bytes. It does not demonstrate command delivery, execution, response, or recovery on the M1.

next_evidence_required: After root copies attempt008, independently verify the saved raw nonce response, exact challenge input, captured launcher/inspector/controller identities, candidate image binding and verified Linux recovery. No completion claim follows from this report.
